summary: scripts/st-test --push asks this host's evidence log to pull at once (systemctl --user start --no-block evidence-log.service, when that unit is installed), so an agent's pass is logged in seconds instead of at the next 2-minute pull.

replay.detail: No record, signature or verifier rule changes.

schema.detail: One optional environment variable, ST_EVIDENCE_LOG_NUDGE (a JSON argv), replaces the systemctl command.

rules.detail: Best effort: a missing unit, a failing command or a bad ST_EVIDENCE_LOG_NUDGE prints one line and never changes the exit code.

compatibility.detail: A host without the evidence-log unit behaves as before.

manual.detail: Nothing: st-test is read from main, and the unit is the one the evidence log already installs.

recovery.detail: Revert; the log's timer pulls every 2 minutes regardless.
